work.title: Untitled (Panoramic Mixed-Media)
work.description: Wide-format mixed-media collage on a dominant turquoise ground, incorporating yellow and white painted passages layered with black gestural line drawings, arrows, and schematic figures. Collaged paper fragments with printed imagery punctuate the surface alongside red, green, and gold mark-making across the horizontal composition.
work.composition: wide horizontal panoramic multi-zone layered surface
keywords: layered paper paint ink horizontal composition
